Hi all.

Over the past couple of weeks we have been busy testing a new hosting service. Our traffic has been steadily increasing and we have received several alerts from users and our monitoring system that our service is getting slow / having intermittent downtime. The solution we decided on was to move our hosting service to Amazon and deploy several servers to handle the HTTP traffic and image processing tasks.

What does this mean for you? Well, you can expect better performance and up time. In order to accomplish this, it will require longer than usual downtime than other maintenance. Here is what the timeline should look like.

11:45PM 2/21/2016 - I will be disabling uploads.

12:00AM 2/22/2016 - I will take final snapshot of sli.mg database.

12:00AM 2/22/2016 - I will update DNS records to point to new server address.

12:20AM 2/22/2016 - I will have database imported into new server and final configurations done.

12:30AM 2/22/2016 - I will perform system tests on new servers to ensure they are working as expected.

12:45AM 2/22/2016 - I will enable uploads on new servers.

So the entire process should be done in an hour or so, hopefully less. I'll post an update thread once it is completed.

Once we get the service up and running on our new servers, I will go back to adding some cool new features to sli.mg. I'll make a separate post about what I have planned and you guys can give me some input on what features are most important to you.

Thank you!

EDIT

As always, direct images will continue to work during this time as they are served from a separate CDN network.
